name: How much does a custom kitchen typically cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does a custom kitchen typically cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom kitchen in Los Angeles varies significantly based on size, complexity, materials, and appliances. While a basic renovation might start lower, a luxury custom kitchen, characteristic of Opus Builders' projects, can range from $75,000 to well over $200,000. This estimate includes design fees, high-end cabinetry, premium countertops, professional-grade appliances, and expert installation. We provide a detailed, transparent quote after understanding your specific requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom kitchen costs in Los Angeles vary widely, typically ranging from $75,000 to over $200,000 for luxury designs, depending on materials and scope.
